scenario: Organize the recovery case after I found an unfamiliar credit account and received a tax-account notice. Use only the redacted bureau, issuer, tax-agency, and identity-recovery records I supplied. Do not contact anyone, file anything, access accounts, freeze credit, or decide that fraud occurred.
